gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-arme: Noto Serif Armenian reads open and approachable, with generous counters in every small letter and a mild thick-and-thin pulse. Funnel Display sits against it like tubing that never thins through a bend, and the two feel confidently different.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-bali: Noto Serif Balinese reads editorial and tall, its strokes sturdy at the thin end. Funnel Display's diagonals carry the weight of its stems, while the serif body over a longer stretch settles into a restrained, traditional texture that never turns stark.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-beng: Plotter-pen lines, one weight all the way round: that is Funnel Display, set against a refined serif with slightly thinner hairlines and trimmed ascenders. Noto Serif Bengali reads smoothly and steadily over a long page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-deva: Noto Serif Devanagari brings a literary classic serif feel, with slightly thinner curves on rounded tops and a big, short-ascender lowercase body. Funnel Display's drawn-wire line gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-dive: Funnel Display makes round letters with walls as heavy as its straight ones, bold and unbroken. Noto Serif Dives Akuru follows with short capitals among tall small letters and a soft contrast, so a long passage reads smoothly and never looks flat.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-dogr: Funnel Display has no thick-thin pulse at all, just one steady line that carries the eye on its own. Noto Serif Dogra adds a faint, crayon-like variation in its text serif strokes, with capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-ethi: Funnel Display excels at uninterrupted monoline strokes that grab attention and hold it through every bend and turn. Noto Serif Ethiopic does the quieter job, its text serif words forming solid blocks.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-geor: Rounds and stems in a single weight give Funnel Display its tubular, commanding look, and the body answers it well. Noto Serif Georgian runs in-between in contrast, its tightly coiled lowercase making a text serif that feels authoritative.
